environment.description: Identical Node.js 18 Express application on ECS Fargate behind ALB. Secrets (ADMIN_PASSWORD, USER_PASSWORD) are sourced from AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation configured via a Lambda rotator on a 60-second schedule (rotation window: immediate, staging labels applied atomically). The rotation Lambda generates cryptographically random 64-character passwords and updates the AWSCURRENT staging label. ECS task definition references the secret ARN with valueFrom, and the ECS service is configured with `enable-execute-command: false` and force-new-deployment triggered by Secrets Manager rotation event via EventBridge rule. Container instances are recycled on each rotation event (rolling deployment with minimum healthy percent 100%, maximum 200%), meaning the in-memory process restarts every ~60 seconds. Additionally, the task IAM role has a permission boundary that denies ssm:GetParameter* and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue except during task initialization (condition: aws:ViaAWSService equals ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com). CloudWatch Container Insights monitors Object.prototype enumerable property count via a custom metric emitted by a sidecar container running a V8 heap inspector on a Unix domain socket.
